product_summary: Website jinkushal.com (Jinkushal Sales Corporation, D 31/C Gallops Industrial Park II, Changodar, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 382213) presents itself as a supplier of JCB spare parts, Perkins and Cummins engines and complete earth-moving machines. Published catalogue (19 of 19 visible items, full catalogue of 800+ parts behind member login): stabiliser ram assy 556/60402, recon engine 320/45010RI, exhaust valve 320/03521, inlet valve 320/03520, fuel injection pump 320/06924, Gates auto tensioner pulley 320/A8586, Garrett turbocharger 320/06047, cooler cover assy 320/04147K, Corteco hub seal 904/M6779, Sanden AC compressor 320/08562, loader arm bush 808/00296, tipping link bush 809/00125, bucket pin 911/12400, front bucket pin 811/80001, tooth bolt and nut 826/00303, tooth and side cutter set 335/Y1458, swing bush dust seal 123/04237/808/00388, Gates fan belts 1250/1232, seal kit slew cylinder 550/42261. In-house manufacturing since 2003 at Changodar: pins, bronze and steel bushes, hydraulic cylinders, engine parts. Complete machines (backhoe loaders, excavators, bulldozers) offered new and second-hand; machine export claimed since 2020. Authorised Perkins dealer and Gates distributor for Gujarat (self-declared).
role_hint: manufacturer_trader - trading of JCB/Perkins/Cummins/Gates branded parts plus own manufacturing of pins, bushes, cylinders and engine parts; also machine reseller (new and used). Trader signs: multi-brand resale, part-number-based catalogue, member-gated price list, no own machine brand.
comment: Declared HS 842911/842952 (bulldozers, excavators) and 870410/870899 (dumpers, vehicle parts) cover only the machine side, while the actual published catalogue is dominated by PARTS of earth-moving machinery, which belong to 843149, plus engines 840820/840999, hydraulic cylinders 841221, bushes 848330, seals 848490, belts 401031 and fasteners 731815. So the declaration is partial: the machine codes are plausible for the 'machines since 2020' line but the core parts business is not declared at all. Industry label 'Строительство и DIY' is a misclassification - this is earth-moving/construction-equipment aftermarket (parts, engines, used machines), not DIY retail. Product lines missing from the declaration: engine parts, hydraulic cylinders/rams, bushes and pins, seal kits, belts, turbochargers, AC compressors, fasteners. All product data above is from the company's own website (jinkushal.com home, /products, /about) - i.e. заявлено, не подтверждено; no customs line was checked in this task, so no HS code here is corroborated by a shipment record. Note also a naming discrepancy: the website operates as 'Jinkushal Sales Corporation', while the batch names 'Jinkushal Industries Private Limited / Limited' - the link between the two entities is not established on the site and is not verified here. Per project rule 3, the HS mismatch is not a rejection ground: company is kept, codes corrected to the actual product mix.
